text:
**Summary:** From 1 November, Tallis Valley Hospital will raise parking fees. The first hour stays free, then the hourly rate goes from $3 to $4 and the daily cap from $18 to $24. The health service says the money will fund repairs to the 1994 car park, where concrete cancer has closed 180 spaces. Repairs should take 18 months.

A new $15 weekly concession pass will replace the current $9 daily concession. It is open to frequent visitors, such as chemotherapy and dialysis patients, and to carers of patients staying more than seven days. Applicants need a letter from their treating team. Forms will be available from 20 October at reception and online.

Staff are unaffected. A petition for free regional hospital parking has over 2,000 signatures.
